title: NMRFinesse: automation, parameter optimisation and quality control for Bruker multidimensional NMR data
description: NMRFinesse automates Bruker multidimensional NMR processing with NMRPipe and SMILE, records processing parameters and quality-control decisions, and provides spectrum viewing and peak localization. Version 1.0.10 improves viewer sections, font sizing, overlay ranges, scroll margins and peak-table layout. GUI peak exports contain assignments and chemical shifts only, and export controls remain available after peak picking. The Python/CLI API remains 1.1.5; detection, noise and threshold calculations are unchanged.
